title: Communication-Efficient Hierarchical Federated Learning via Coordinated Model-Guided Feature Selection and Bidirectional Low-Rank Compression
description: Reproducibility release accompanying the revised Scientific Reports manuscript. Includes hierarchical federated learning source, configurations, recorded seed-level results, table and figure reconstruction scripts, and validation tests. Main protocols cover Fashion-MNIST, UCI HAR and CIFAR-10; separate 50-round diagnostics are labelled exploratory.
